FUTURE-READY WITH AI

Where Innovation Meets Opportunity

Lead the future of business with flexible programs that combine your expertise with AI innovation.

Begin Your Journey

Choose Your Path to Success

California Miramar University (CalMU) is an online and hybrid university offering flexible programs designed for students, working professionals, and career changers.

Earn a certificate, associate degree, bachelor’s degree, or master’s degree online — and gain credentials you can add to your resume and use to pursue new career opportunities.

  • 100% Online Programs — No need to attend a physical campus
  • Accelerated 8-Week Courses — Keep your education moving forward
  • Flexible Learning — Study when and where it works for you
  • Certificates, Associate, Bachelor’s & Master’s Degrees
  • Business, Technology, AI & Cybersecurity Programs
  • Nationally Accredited by DEAC
  • Multiple Start Dates Throughout the Year
  • Dedicated Student Advisors — Personalized, one-on-one support to help students throughout their educational journey. 

Whether you're looking to start your career, advance in your current field, or build new skills, CalMU gives you a flexible way to earn a recognized academic credential while balancing work and life.

Your next career opportunity could start with your next credential.

School of Technology

Certificate in Artificial Intelligence (18 Credit Program)

Duration: 6 months

Locations: 100% Online, San Diego, San Jose

Gain cutting-edge knowledge and tools to enter or grow within the AI space. This 18-credit program includes foundational business knowledge and specialized AI coursework.

Certificate in Cybersecurity (18 Credit Program)

Duration: 6 months

Locations: 100% Online, San Diego, San Jose

Become job-ready with core cyber security skills including network fundamentals, cryptography, and ethical hacking. Aligned with CompTIA and Microsoft certifications.
